name: SUPRA Job Scheduler
description: Manages job lifecycle: queue → plan → route → execute → complete. Supports parallelism, dependencies, and retries.

pipeline.name: Queue
pipeline.description: Job enters queue with priority and state QUEUED

pipeline.name: Planner
pipeline.description: Planner checks dependencies and resolves BLOCKED state

pipeline.name: Router
pipeline.description: Router selects provider, model, and agent for the job

pipeline.name: Worker
pipeline.description: Worker executes the job via assigned agent

pipeline.name: Completed
pipeline.description: Job marked SUCCESS or FAILED, recorded in history
